text:
Alex P: Quick async check — planning a percent-based canary for model v9 today (NA -> EU). Plan: 1% for 20min, then 5% for 40min, then 20% if green. Any objections?

Samir G: +1 from infra side. Can we confirm the feature flag name and rollout API call?

Alex P: Flag is feature.flags.model_v9_rollout. Command I'm going to use: `/ff set feature.flags.model_v9_rollout --percent=1 --region=na` then increment.

Mia Chen: Looks fine. Guardrails we discussed earlier: p95 latency delta >20% vs baseline OR error rate >0.5% absolute => abort. Also add a quality check (eval set) for hallucination delta >0.03.

Priya K: Adding cost guardrail: if cost per token increases >15% we hold and investigate. Also request we don't include VIP/enterprise customers in the first two slices.

Jon T: I'll create the routing rule to exclude customer_tier=enterprise for the 1% and 5% slices. Will push in ~5m.

Alex P: Thx Jon. Can you paste the rule when done so I can verify?

Jon T: Pasted: `route if user.customer_tier != "enterprise" and region == "na" -> model_v9`

Samir G: On infra autoscaling — this workload will increase a little. I'm upping the min workers by 1 for the NA pool for the duration of the canary window. Will revert after.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] feature.flags.model_v9_rollout set to 1% in region=na by Alex P

Mia Chen: Quick note on metrics: we'll watch p95 latency, 99th tail, token cost, 5-shot eval on the regression set, and the online rejection rate (safety). I've added the charts to the dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/d/rollouts/model-v9-canary

Alex P: Abort checklist (copying here): 1) p95 latency increase >20% OR p99 >50% increase, 2) error rate >0.5% absolute, 3) hallucination eval delta >0.03, 4) user-facing complaints spike (>3 in 10m), 5) cost per token >15% delta. If any hit, flip flag back to 0% and tag @eng-oncall.

Priya K: Also add: if regional SLOs degrade (>=1 availability zone impact) escalate.

eng-oncall-bot: [oncall] Pager duty alert channel: #eng-oncall. Thresholds registered for model_v9_canary.

Samir G: One more operational guard — enable automatic fallback to model_v8 on errors >0.3%. We have that route prepped; recommend enabling during the 5% step.

Alex P: Good call. I'll enable fallback at 5%. Timeline: start at 14:10 UTC with 1% NA, check at 14:30, bump to 5% at 14:35 (enable fallback), check at 15:15, bump to 20% at 15:20 if green, then region=eu starting 16:00 with same sequence.

Mia Chen: I'll keep an eye on the eval harness and leave small notes in the dashboard.

Jon T: Done — routing rule live and enterprise exclusion confirmed.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] routing rule updated by Jon T

Alex P: Perfect. If anyone wants to opt-out a test token or specific user to be excluded, DM me now. Otherwise I'll kick this off at 14:10.

Priya K: No blockers from security. Make sure KMS keys for logs are applied (they are).

Samir G: Reverting plan note: I'll automatedly revert min workers after 2 hours unless you tell me to keep it.

Alex P: Okay — kicking off in 2m. Will post a short status update after first 1% window. :rocket:
